apply_phong_shading: apply per pixel Phong shading to a batch of meshes using barycentric interpolation and lighting
apply_gouraud_shading: apply per vertex Gouraud shading to meshes with TexturesVertex and interpolate colors per pixel
apply_flat_shading: apply per face flat shading to meshes using average face position and face normals
review_apply_lighting: review the _apply_lighting function to understand how ambient, diffuse, and specular colors are computed
refactor_shading_functions: refactor the shading functions to support a new lighting model or material property
